author: GitHub
description:
Managing GitHub Copilot across a large enterprise requires flexible budgeting that aligns with your organizational structure. In this video, we show you how to map enterprise teams to cost centers so membership stays synchronized automatically. Learn how to configure cost center AI credit pools, apply user-level spending caps, and set up individual overrides for your power users. These features help you manage enterprise AI spending efficiently at scale.
